fact: The strategy states the e-Government Interoperability Framework standards and policies were last updated in 2014, that existing MAC integrations use institution-specific peer-to-peer APIs with no standardized APIs, and lists development of an interoperability platform by MoPT (2025-2026) as ongoing.
title: Government of Liberia 'Whole of Government' National Digital Strategy
publisher: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications (Government of Liberia)
